skill.description: Generate daily standup updates through a guided interview. The skill can optionally add approved GitHub, Git, Jira, and Claude Code activity context.
skill.summary: Prepare concise daily standup updates with optional activity context.
skill.author: softaworks

security_audit.summary: Most static backtick and reconnaissance findings are markdown examples, quoted prompts, or interview text. Confirmed issues are the intended local command execution and reads from ~/.claude/projects, which can expose sensitive Claude Code history despite consent prompts. No prompt injection text or unauthorized network exfiltration was found.

remediation.suggestion: Ask for explicit consent immediately before running the digest, show the directory and date range, and avoid storing raw session content.
Document every command, keep arguments fixed where possible, quote project paths, and never interpolate untrusted text into a shell.
Provide a preflight summary before checking authenticated tools or hidden history paths, especially on shared machines.

content.value_statement: Daily standup preparation often misses work spread across tickets, commits, and conversations. This skill interviews you and, with approval, adds GitHub, Jira, Git, and Claude Code context.
actual_capabilities: Runs a four-question interview about yesterday, today, blockers, and discussion topics.
Offers GitHub, Git, Jira, and Claude Code context only when available and approved.
Summarizes commits, pull requests, reviews, tickets, and selected Claude Code sessions.
Lets users exclude personal or irrelevant sessions before generating the update.
Formats the final response as concise Markdown for a daily meeting.
limitations: Automatic context depends on local tools, authentication, and available history files.
Claude Code history may include sensitive project names or session summaries.
The skill does not verify whether every pulled activity is relevant to the meeting.
It cannot access Jira or GitHub data unless compatible tools are configured.

use_cases.title: Prepare a developer standup
use_cases.description: Build a short update from recent work, planned tasks, blockers, and selected activity context.

use_cases.title: Summarize sprint progress
use_cases.description: Combine Jira tickets and pull request activity into a readable status update before team sync.

use_cases.title: Recall scattered work
use_cases.description: Use approved Claude Code session history to remember research, debugging, and planning work.

prompt_templates.title: Start a basic daily update
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me prepare my daily standup update.

prompt_templates.title: Use approved GitHub context
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare my standup update and ask before checking GitHub or Git activity.

prompt_templates.title: Add Jira ticket context
prompt_templates.scenario: Include assigned tickets and recent ticket changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create my daily update with Jira context if you detect a configured Jira tool.

prompt_templates.title: Review all available sources
prompt_templates.scenario: Use the full interview flow with selective activity review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a complete standup update. Ask before using GitHub, Jira, Git, or Claude Code history, then let me select relevant items.

output_examples.input: User asks for a daily update and answers the interview manually.
output_examples.output: A short standup note with sections for yesterday, today, blockers, and topics for discussion.

output_examples.input: User approves GitHub and Jira context for selected projects.
output_examples.output: A meeting-ready update that includes approved pull requests, reviews, tickets, and human-written context.

output_examples.input: User approves Claude Code history and selects three relevant sessions.
output_examples.output: A concise update that includes selected session summaries while excluding personal or unrelated work.

best_practices: Approve only the repositories, tickets, and sessions that belong in the meeting.
Add context for why work mattered, not only what changed.
Keep the final update short enough to read in under two minutes.
anti_patterns: Do not pull activity from personal or unrelated projects.
Do not skip the blocker and discussion-topic questions.
Do not publish raw ticket numbers or pull request links without summaries.

faq.question: Can this skill work without integrations?
faq.answer: Yes. It can run the interview and generate a standup update from manual answers only.

faq.question: Does it access GitHub or Jira automatically?
faq.answer: It detects available tools, then asks before pulling activity from approved sources.

faq.question: What does the Claude Code history option read?
faq.answer: It reads local Claude Code session metadata from the user home directory when approved.

faq.question: Can I exclude personal work?
faq.answer: Yes. The flow asks you to select relevant sessions before they are included.

faq.question: What format does it generate?
faq.answer: It generates a Markdown update with sections for yesterday, today, blockers, and discussion topics.

faq.question: Is it suitable for Codex and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code support.
